examples.japanese: {平常|へいじょう}{通|どお}りに{営業|えいぎょう}しています。
{平常|へいじょう}{心|しん}を{保|たも}つことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to keep a calm mind.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{後|ご}、{平常|へいじょう}の{生活|せいかつ}に{戻|もど}るまで{長|なが}い{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: After the disaster, it took a long time to return to normal life.

notes:
Refers to the state of things being normal, especially as contrasted with exceptional or emergency situations. Composed of {平|へい} (flat, calm) and {常|じょう} (always, ordinary). The compound {平常心|へいじょうしん} (equanimity, calm composure) is particularly common in martial arts and sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平常|へいじょう}{心|しん}: composure, equanimity
- {平常|へいじょう}{通|どお}り: as usual, as normal
- {平常|へいじょう}{時|じ}: normal times (as opposed to emergencies)
- {平常|へいじょう}{運転|うんてん}: normal operation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普通|ふつう}: normal, ordinary — the most common everyday word
- {通常|つうじょう}: usual, ordinary — slightly more formal, common in writing
- {日常|にちじょう}: daily life, everyday — emphasizes routine
